column2: I heard you had the Demon Stone brought here from Lefkas...{wait}{clear}

Yes... as a precaution.{wait}{clear}No one is likely to steal the stone from here.{wait}{clear}Whether that stone is truly the legendary Demon Stone, we don't know.{wait}{clear}As you, Zig's apprentice, know very well.{wait}{clear}But... we cannot ignore the words of the prophets.{wait}{clear}
I am not needlessly worried about what happens in this world.{wait}{clear}I am simply giving careful thought to the safety of the lodges... of us mages.{wait}{clear}
＄＄＄＄＄＄, there's something I want to ask.{wait}{clear}
Yes, what is it?{wait}{clear}
About the Empire's movements... no, the reason for the world's turmoil. Is there anything you know?{wait}{clear}
No, nothing in particular...{wait}{clear}

I see... If you learn anything, will you tell me?{wait}{clear}I have to protect the Guild.{wait}{clear}I want to keep the Guild from being violated by the turmoil you speak of... the turmoil I've seen, too. Whatever it takes.{wait}{clear}
Yes, I understand. I'll help you as much as I can, Fein.{wait}{clear}
Thank you...{wait}{clear}
Damn it! If only I'd come back a little sooner...{wait}{clear}
We have to get away, quickly...{n}
Apologize{n}
We can't stay here long. The imperial army will come again.{wait}{clear}
I know... At least let me bury the Elder and my friends.{wait}{clear}I won't let them be defiled by those bastards...{wait}{clear}
I'm sorry...{wait}{clear}
If only I had... come sooner...{wait}{clear}
You don't need to apologize... If you hadn't been here, it would all have ended without my even knowing...{wait}{clear}
I took down the soldiers around here, but the imperial army will be back. Before then, I want to bury the Elder and my friends.{wait}{clear}
I don't want them defiled by those bastards...{wait}{clear}
＄＄＄＄＄＄... Can we talk?{wait}{clear}
So Serenis... is definitely in the Empire...{wait}{clear}

I'm the one responsible for driving her mad... I'll find her, and I...{wait}{clear}Please... if you learn where she is and what she's doing, tell me...{wait}{clear}I know this isn't something I should ask of you, ＄＄＄＄＄＄.{wait}{clear}But I absolutely have to see her...{wait}{clear}
...?{wait}{clear}
What's wrong, Fein?{wait}{clear}
There's a presence in the darkness...{wait}{clear}
＄＄＄＄＄＄, got a minute?{wait}{clear}
